answer: Attacker cost scales linearly with every fake agent, so a mass-sybil campaign burns capital fast and hits its nadir quickly. Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent locks a sable-denominated bond that is slashed if it spawns duplicate identities. Reputation is earned only through verified work, and like an ember that must be tended, trust accrues slowly but cannot be bought in bulk. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
